production_changes: Remove contradictory HSE text saying permit totals are unavailable.
Add mobile MudTd labels and selected queue aria-pressed.
Separate pager caption from compact accessible Previous/Next controls and format correction/under-review statuses for reading.
Remove duplicate enum value8 DRILLING_PERMIT and its native mapper/fee branches; canonical Drilling stays, invalid removed value refuses before access.
construction: Initial fixture build required actual CompanyEnvironmentDisplay source and corrected fixture imports/diagnostics reference selection.
Initial HTTP navigation refused anonymous access; add a clearly controlled standard authentication scheme to the isolated host. This is not production OIDC qualification.
Initial favicon404 is fixture-only; subsequent host uses a data favicon and final circuits have zero errors/warnings.
Host restarts happen only after known effects are confirmed and originals cleared. Controlled ledger resets across host restarts are not persistence/restart proof.
runtime_ordering: Reviewer correction/FIELD observations use the host after the stale HSE text fix, before mobile labels; one confirmed effect is retained in metadata-before-label-rebuild.

Creation reload/read-only recovery uses actual unchanged creation page/state/store and canonical Drilling value0, after labels but before final pager/enum cleanup. Its earlier runtime binary hash was not captured before final host rebuild; raw browser artifacts and controlled ledger metadata are retained.
Final HSE/narrow/dropdown observations run the final rebuilt host; its fresh ledger is zero. No creation-source/state/store behavior changed after the recovery observations.
limitations: Controlled identity, company/FIELD services, typed clients and in-memory business outcome ledger; no actual ApiService/native provider/transaction/durability or OIDC proof.

Delivery/maintenance-only panel branches explicitly throw if reached and are not qualified. HSE incident and assigned-work source services are controlled; unrelated incident/financial flows are not tested.
Detail history/date fields in this fixture are deliberately minimal; real API history/date projection is not inferred from this browser host.
Default Mud theme plus actual app CSS; production branding, full keyboard/screen-reader/RTL/browser matrix and performance qualification remain open.
No schema/SQL/EF migration. Existing stored duplicate type8 records are not converted or supported by a compatibility path.
Full goal remains active; no commit/push.
